Container.Name: outriggarr
Container.Overview: YouTube to Sonarr/Radarr bridge. Fills wanted lists from YouTube (or any yt-dlp site) via subscriptions and manual grabs, stages downloads in a shared folder, and hands files to Sonarr/Radarr through their manual-import API so they rename, move and notify as usual. Run with the same PUID/PGID as your *arr containers and mount the staging folder into all of them.

Config.Name: Host Port for 8080
Config.Description: Web GUI and JSON API (no built-in auth; keep it behind your proxy for anything beyond the LAN)

Config.Name: Host Path for /config
Config.Description: SQLite database, cookies file, deno cache

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your media data share, mapped exactly as in Sonarr/Radarr. Downloads are staged in the folder below; the *arr moves them into its library on the same filesystem (atomic rename).

Config.Name: Staging folder (inside the container)
Config.Description: Enter the same path as the 'staging path' of each connection in Settings → Connections.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Match Sonarr/Radarr so they can move staged files

Config.Name: Update yt-dlp on start
Config.Description: 1 = pip-upgrade yt-dlp every time the container starts (needs internet)
